entry.name: FusionX Multimodal Sample Data
entry.title: FusionX Multimodal Sample Dataset (V2 and V3)
entry.summary: Two TouchTronix conductive-fabric tactile gloves (5 x 4x3 finger patches + 4x15 palm per hand, raw 0-255, glove ~197 Hz resampled to 30 Hz, one bend sensor per finger) with an OAK-D Pro W egocentric camera (720p RGB, 640x400 mono stereo, depth in V2), in 37 short recordings (~20.5 min) of first-aid kit, strap, water pouring, box cutting, drilling, screwing and syringe tasks.
entry.hand: TouchTronix FusionX conductive-fabric tactile gloves, both hands

sensor.note: Per hand and camera frame: <hand>_<finger>_pressure (12,) uint8 for thumb, index, middle, ring, little (4x3 each) + <hand>_palm_pressure (60,) uint8 (4x15), raw 0-255; *_pressure_cal = raw minus the per-taxel zero in calib.json (not a physical unit); finger_bend (5,) raw + finger_bend_cal 0-1 normalised; glove IMU quaternion. Glove sampled at ~197 Hz (dataset_info: glove_measured_fps; 'fps': 188) and matched to each 30 fps camera frame by nearest neighbour.
sensor.model: FusionX conductive-fabric tactile glove (data format of the v1-conductive-fabric SDK)

scale.text: 37 recordings, ~20.5 min, 36,991 frames @30 fps: V3 repo 11 recordings (first-aid kit x3, strap x4, water x4; 8.8 min, 2026-05-07), V2 repo 26 recordings (box cut, drill, screw/unscrew, syringe, water pour x5 each + 1 test; 11.8 min, 2026-03-13)

entry.access: Two ungated Hugging Face repos, touchtronix/FusionX-Multimodal-Sample-Data-V3 (15.9 GB, per-frame JPG/PNG folders) and -V2 (19.8 GB, H.264 RGB + lossless depth MKV + zipped frames); one folder per recording with frames.parquet holding all glove data.
caveats: The repo labels V2 and V3 are dataset versions, not glove generations: both use the conductive-fabric glove format (4x3 per finger, 4x15 palm, one bend value per finger). The catalog's FusionX V3 thin-film glove (5 x 4x4, no palm) is a different sensor and is not in these files.
Tactile values are raw 0-255 counts; the '_cal' columns are zero-offset subtracted (calib.json tactile_zero_*), not force or pressure units.
Finger tracking is one bend value per finger (raw and min-max normalised), not joint angles; no wrist position.

Glove gyro and accelerometer are all zero in the V3 recordings (only the quaternion is populated); the V3 OAK IMU sits in a separate oak_imu.parquet on the device clock (~199 Hz), while the V2 frames.parquet carries it per frame.
Glove samples are matched to camera frames (nearest neighbour, 30 fps); the full ~197 Hz glove stream is not released, and glove_timestamp equals the frame timestamp (glove_dt_ms 0).
Task names exist only as folder names (firstaid1, strap2, waterpour3, ...); no task descriptions, objects or subject counts are given.
Short sample release: 37 recordings of 15-96 s; V3 has no depth stream.
Separate from the provider-supplied FusionX clips in the catalog viewer (source 'fusionx', thin-film glove).

tracking.system: glove bend sensors, one per finger
tracking.note: finger_bend raw (0-160 seen) and finger_bend_cal normalised 0-1 with per-user bend_min/bend_max in calib.json

tracking.system: glove IMU (fused quaternion w, x, y, z)
tracking.note: orientation only; gyro/accel zero in V3
accel + gyro (V3, ~199 Hz, device clock); quaternion + accel + gyro per frame (V2)

other: camera intrinsics, distortion and mono/IMU-to-RGB extrinsics (calib.json)
per-user tactile zero and bend range (calib.json)

sources: https://huggingface.co/datasets/touchtronix/FusionX-Multimodal-Sample-Data-V3 (README.md, file listing, all 11 frames.parquet and oak_imu.parquet, water1/calib.json, water1/rgb/000300.jpg, strap1/rgb/000800.jpg)

https://huggingface.co/datasets/touchtronix/FusionX-Multimodal-Sample-Data-V2 (README.md, dataset_info.json, file listing, all 26 frames.parquet and calib.json, video_meta.json of 6 recordings, waterpour1/rgb.mp4 via ffprobe)

https://github.com/TouchTronix-Robotics/FusionX-DataCollection (branches v1-conductive-fabric, v2-conductive-fabric, v3-thimfilm; v1 docs/tactile-glove-sdk-api.md; v2 README.md and docs/glove-map-rh.png)
unconfirmed: Glove generation: inferred from the data layout. frames.parquet has 12 values per finger and 60 palm values (dataset_info: finger_shape [4, 3], palm_shape [4, 15]) and one bend value per finger, which matches the v1-conductive-fabric SDK (12 pressure values per finger, palm list, one bend per finger). The v2-conductive-fabric SDK has a 5x15 palm with 72 populated cells and two bend values per finger; the v3 thin-film glove has 5 x 4x4 and no palm. Neither HF card names the glove version.
taxels_per_hand=120 = 5 x 12 + 60, counted from the columns.
coverage 'tip' is inferred from one 4x3 patch per finger; where on the finger the patch sits is not stated (as in the catalog's FusionX V3 hardware entry). 'palm' is stated by the column names.
hours=0.34 and frames=36,991: frame counts and first-to-last timestamps of all 37 frames.parquet files (V3 15,783 frames / 525.7 s; V2 21,208 frames / 706.3 s, matching dataset_info.json 706.24 s).

tasks=8 from folder-name stems (firstaid, strap, water, box_cut, drill, screwunscrew, syringe, waterpour); the V3 README calls its 11 folders '11 distinct tasks', and V2 also has one 'test1' recording. V3 'water' and V2 'waterpour' are counted separately; their content was not compared.
Camera model 'OAK-D Pro W' from V2 dataset_info.json; V3 says 'on-board OAK IMU' only. Mount not stated; the RGB frames checked look forward and down onto a table from about head height.
Dates from the frame UNIX timestamps (V3 water1: 2026-05-07) and dataset_info 'created' (V2: 2026-03-13).
subjects not stated; every V2 video_meta.json checked (6 of 26) names the same calibration user.

Contact check over all 37 recordings: zero-subtracted readings above 20 on at least 2 of 6 regions per hand for >= 1 s in every recording; V3 left-hand readings stay low in the water recordings (2-3 regions).

download.format: One folder per recording. V3: calib.json, frames.parquet, oak_imu.parquet, mono_left/*.png and mono_right/*.png (640x400), rgb/*.jpg (1280x720). V2: calib.json, frames.parquet, video_meta.json, rgb.mp4 (H.264 1280x720 CRF 15), depth.mkv (FFV1 gray16le), preview_all/depth/glove.mp4, plus rgb/depth/mono_left/mono_right .zip of the raw frames; dataset_info.json at the root.
download.per_episode: frames.parquet 0.2-0.6 MB (all glove data); V3 RGB JPG folder 212-443 MB per recording (mono PNG folders larger); V2 rgb.mp4 65-153 MB
download.partial_fetch: single files via https://huggingface.co/datasets/touchtronix/FusionX-Multimodal-Sample-Data-<V2|V3>/resolve/main/<recording>/<file>; the README's snapshot_download(allow_patterns='<recording>/*') also works

channels.frame: OAK-D Pro W RGB; intrinsics/distortion in calib.json
channels.note: frames.parquet rgb_path per frame; V2 mp4 is H.264 yuvj420p

channels.name: mono_left, mono_right
channels.frame: own frames; mono-to-RGB extrinsics in calib.json (calib lists 1280x720 intrinsics)

channels.name: oak_imu (V3 oak_imu.parquet; V2 frames.parquet oak_imu_*)
channels.shape: V3: timestamp + accel xyz + gyro xyz; V2: quaternion (4) + gyro (3) + accel (3) per frame
channels.frame: OAK IMU; imu_to_rgb extrinsic in calib.json
channels.note: V3 file on the device clock (12,850 s in water1), not UNIX time; V3 frames.parquet oak_imu_quaternion is null; V2 is per frame (30 Hz)

channels.note: nearest glove sample per camera frame; glove native ~197 Hz

channels.note: the V2 README calls these 'Calibrated Pressure'; no physical unit

channels.name: <lh|rh>_imu_quaternion, _imu_gyro, _imu_accel

channels.name: preview_all.mp4, preview_depth.mp4, preview_glove.mp4 (V2 only)

sample.fetch_estimate: ~1.6 GB: V3 RGB JPG folders 336 + 443 + 212 MB (mono PNG not needed), V2 rgb.mp4 146 + 145 + 153 + 74 + 65 MB; all 37 frames.parquet (~15 MB) were already fetched for the survey. Re-hosted media: V3 JPG sequences must be encoded to H.264; V2 rgb.mp4 is already H.264 (CRF 15) but large, so re-encode at lower bitrate (a few MB per clip). Episode JSON: 56 s x 30 Hz x 240 uint8 values ~ 0.4M numbers, under 2 MB as integers.
sample.rules_applied: Tasks: 8 named tasks (folder stems; 'test' excluded), 6-8 rule allows all 8, which span both repo versions, one- and two-handed work, tool use (drill, screwdriver, cutter, syringe) and pouring. Episodes: one per task, 8 in total. Each has all 12 tactile arrays (5 fingers + palm per hand, uint8, no gaps) and zero-subtracted readings above 20 for >= 1 s on both hands. Lengths 20-56 s, within 10-60 s, so no window. Budget: within 2 MB JSON, ~30 MB media per episode after re-encoding, and 20 GB download.
